business.name: Daily diagnosis mean minutes
business.nrql: FROM WorkshopReportSnapshot SELECT latest(diagnosis_total_seconds) / latest(diagnosis_samples) / 60 WHERE environment = '$environment' AND window_kind = 'day' AND diagnosis_samples > 0 FACET business_date SINCE 3 minutes ago

business.name: Seven-day execution mean minutes
business.nrql: FROM WorkshopReportSnapshot SELECT latest(execution_total_seconds) / latest(execution_samples) / 60 WHERE environment = '$environment' AND window_kind = 'rolling_7_day' AND execution_samples > 0 SINCE 3 minutes ago

business.name: Orders and exclusions
business.nrql: FROM WorkshopReportSnapshot SELECT latest(created_count), latest(eligible_count), latest(excluded_count) WHERE environment = '$environment' AND window_kind = 'day' FACET business_date SINCE 3 minutes ago

operations.name: Outbox blocked and age
operations.nrql: FROM WorkshopOutboxHealth SELECT latest(blocked_count), latest(oldest_pending_seconds) WHERE environment = '$environment' SINCE 3 minutes ago

operations.name: Snapshot heartbeat and drops
operations.nrql: FROM WorkshopTelemetryHeartbeat SELECT latest(drop_count) WHERE environment = '$environment' SINCE 3 minutes ago

status.name: Current order status age
status.nrql: FROM WorkshopStatusSnapshot SELECT latest(current_count), latest(max_age_seconds), latest(unknown_age_count) WHERE environment = '$environment' FACET status SINCE 3 minutes ago

noData: A sample count of zero and a missing event in the three-minute capture window are displayed as N/A/no data. Widgets use latest() by capture timestamp, not arrival time; rolling means never average daily averages.
